profile.headline: Retired Software Engineer
profile.summary: Senior Staff Software Engineer with over 25 years of C++ experience shipping quality products that push the technical envelope.  I have a passion for solving difficult problems involving large data sets and optimizing the solutions run as fast as possible.  My experience includes domains such as Video Games, Operating Systems, Optimization Tools, and Integrated Circuit Layout Automation.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
I create highly efficient multi-threaded software to generate active test chip content and synthetic pre-design circuit layout for manufacturing process R&D.

My focus is on C++ algorithms and data structures to designed to analyze and manipulate billions of rectangular and polygonal objects physical layout objects in a design.

In addition, I mentor new engineers on leveraging C++ for our team's High Performance Computing requirements and co-run programming contests which attracts hundreds of participants.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: C++ engineer on QEA, circuit routing software internal to Intel.  I focus primarily on metal-fill and via-fill algorithms, as well as delivering increased software performance through the use of parallel-processing.

positions.title: Graphics Software Engineer
positions.description: Design and development of the "Frame Analyzer" portion of the Intel GPA (Graphics Performance Analyzers) tool suite.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Helped develop the audio stack for the XBox 360 driver and SDK.
Participated in research for TPM-based security products in the Windows OS.
